name: sphinx-daisyui-assets
description: Compiles the theme's stylesheet. Python's build runs it, so users of the theme never need Node.

scripts.build: node scripts/themes.mjs && tailwindcss -i assets/theme.css -o src/sphinx_daisyui/theme/daisyui/static/styles/sphinx-daisyui.css --minify && tailwindcss -i assets/content.css -o src/sphinx_daisyui/theme/daisyui/static/styles/sphinx-daisyui-content.css --minify
